Join us as a “**Python GenAI Developer – AWS Bedrock \& AI Platforms**" at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

Freshers with strong AWS fundamentals, relevant hands\-on projects, internships, or AWS certifications may also be considered.

* Define cloud\-native and application modernization strategies including re\-platforming, re\-architecting, containerization, microservices, and event\-driven architectures
* Provide architecture guidance for migration and modernization of large\-scale enterprise workloads to Azure
* Design and integrate Azure OpenAI and GenAI solutions including enterprise AI assistants, RAG\-based solutions, intelligent search, copilots, and AI\-enabled business applications
* Define patterns for integrating Azure OpenAI with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and knowledge repositories

* Lead architecture workshops and technical discussions with customers, application teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and senior stakeholders
* Develop reference architectures, architecture blueprints, design standards, and reusable cloud patterns
* Participate in RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, technical estimations, architecture presentations, and customer pitches
* Support presales teams in defining solution scope, architecture, delivery approach, effort estimates, assumptions, and technical risks
* Conduct architecture reviews, provide technical governance across cloud transformation programs, and mentor architects and engineering teams across multiple projects or workstreams

**Requirements**

* 16\-22 years of overall IT experience with significant experience in cloud and enterprise architecture roles
* Strong hands\-on architectural expertise in Microsoft Azure
* Deep understanding of Azure platform and systems architecture, including Azure Landing Zones, Management Groups, and Subscriptions
* Proficiency in Hub\-Spoke/Virtual WAN architectures, networking, and private connectivity
* Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, and Azure Policy, along with RBAC, governance, security, monitoring, and observability

* Experience designing application modernization and cloud migration strategies for large enterprise environments
* Expertise in Azure OpenAI Service and GenAI architecture, including integration of LLM\-based capabilities into enterprise applications
* Understanding of RAG, embeddings, and vector search, as well as prompt orchestration, AI agents, and enterprise GenAI architecture patterns
* Consulting and customer\-facing experience with the ability to engage senior technical and business stakeholders, participate in RFPs, RFIs, presales solutioning, estimations, and technical proposal development
* Capability to translate business requirements into scalable and practical cloud architecture

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and Azure Machine Learning
* Background in FinOps and cloud cost optimization
* Exposure to large\-scale cloud migration or modernization programs
* Microsoft Azure Architect or other relevant cloud certifications
* Experience working with global enterprise customers or distributed engineering teams

title: Senior Associate - .NET
description:
### **Description**

  

The Senior Associate \- Full Stack Engineering is a hands\-on full\-stack engineering role, equivalent in scope and expectations to a UK Intermediate Engineer. The role is responsible for building high\-quality user\-facing and back\-end software solutions across the Consulting \& Technology estate.
  

The role provides strong squad\-level technical contribution across the React and .NET ecosystem, including TypeScript, component architecture, C\#, ASP.NET Core, APIs, SQL Server, Azure, automated testing, accessibility, performance, and secure integration patterns.  

  

Working closely with architects, lead engineers, and senior engineers, the role helps translate technical direction into maintainable implementation, follows engineering standards, and contributes to overall delivery quality through good engineering practice.  

This role is ideal for an experienced full\-stack engineer with 6\-8 years' experience who can work independently on well\-defined features, contribute to technical design, and deliver robust web applications and services in Agile engineering squads.### **Key Responsibilities**

 **Full Stack Design \& Development*** Design, build, and maintain high\-quality React, TypeScript, .NET, and C\# applications aligned to architecture and squad priorities.
* Build reusable UI components, API services, domain services, background workers, and integrations using clean architecture and squad patterns.
* Write clean, secure, maintainable front\-end and back\-end code following SOLID, React patterns, domain modelling, and engineering standards.
* Develop client\-side features, API integrations, data layers, and SQL Server / Entity Framework solutions for performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Build responsive, accessible, containerised, and event\-driven components to support scalable, resilient platforms where appropriate.

**Engineering Quality, Testing \& DevOps*** Create and maintain automated tests across unit, component, integration, contract, end\-to\-end, and service layers, using TDD where appropriate.
* Contribute to CI/CD, quality gates, automated deployment, environment setup, static analysis, and release readiness.
* Support observability, resilience, logging, monitoring, alerting, accessibility, and performance tuning.
* Apply secure coding across authentication, authorisation, API use, data handling, dependency management, and service communication.

**Technical Contribution \& Collaboration*** Collaborate with developers through code reviews, pairing, design discussions, and constructive technical feedback.
* Collaborate with junior, mid\-level, and senior developers through code reviews, pairing, design discussion, and constructive technical feedback.
* Contribute to shared full\-stack standards, templates, component and service patterns, and clean architecture practices.
* Support onboarding, knowledge sharing, and technical documentation where full\-stack input is needed.

**Problem Solving \& Support*** Work with Architects, Lead Engineers, QA, Product Owners, and Platform Engineers to resolve cross\-cutting technical issues.
* Improve shared front\-end libraries, back\-end frameworks, reusable components, and platform components where required.

**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement*** Work with Architects, Product Owners, Platform Engineers, QA, and peers to ensure solutions meet business and user needs.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including planning, refinement, retrospectives, technical discovery, and continuous improvement.

**Continuous Improvement \& Innovation*** Identify practical improvements to developer experience, quality, maintainability, accessibility, resilience, and delivery effectiveness.
* Stay current with React, TypeScript, .NET, cloud, clean architecture, testing, accessibility, and integration practices.
* Support continuous learning and engineering improvement across the squad and wider community.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Mandatory:*** 6\-8 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent capability demonstrated through delivery experience.
* Relevant experience delivering modern full\-stack applications using React, TypeScript, C\#, .NET, APIs, and SQL Server in commercial or enterprise environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
* Full\-stack development with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, and modern architecture.
* Front\-end architecture covering hooks, components, routing, forms, validation, state management, responsive design, and reusable UI patterns.
* Back\-end engineering with clean architecture, SOLID, DDD concepts, service boundaries, background services, and maintainable APIs.
* REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, authentication, authorisation, API versioning, and secure integration patterns.
* SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, data modelling, query optimisation, transactions, and data access patterns.
* Automated testing across unit, component, integration, contract, end\-to\-end, and performance layers using relevant tools.
* Azure, CI/CD, Azure DevOps or equivalent tools, dependency management, quality gates, and infrastructure\-as\-code awareness.
* WCAG accessibility, browser compatibility, front\-end performance, observability, logging, monitoring, and secure coding.

**Essential Requirement*** 6\-8 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent capability demonstrated through delivery experience.
* Good hands\-on proficiency in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, and Web API development.
* Experience implementing maintainable front\-end application structures, reusable components, and consistent UI patterns.
* Experience designing and delivering REST APIs, service components, integration patterns, and secure authentication / authorisation flows.
* SQL Server and Entity Framework Core capability, including data modelling and query optimisation awareness.
* Good understanding of clean architecture, SOLID principles, Domain\-Driven Design concepts, and maintainable service design.
* Automated test practices across unit, component, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, code quality tooling, modern DevOps practices, Azure services, and secure coding principles including OWASP awareness.

**Nice to have*** Microservices, containers, event\-driven architecture, messaging, and integrations.
* Advanced front\-end state and data\-fetching patterns, such as Redux, Zustand, or TanStack Query.
* Terraform or similar IaC, cloud observability, performance tuning, and production support.

  

### **About Davies**


We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  

  

We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation \& risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation \& change management.  

  

Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK \& the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20\-fold, investing heavily in research \& development, innovation \& automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

title: AWS Database Migration Architect
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking an experienced **AWS Database Migration Architect** to lead enterprise\-scale database migration and modernization initiatives on AWS. In this role, you will design robust, secure and scalable database solutions while guiding customers through their transformation journey from legacy or on\-premises platforms to modern AWS\-native database services.

**Responsibilities**

* Assess existing database workloads and identify applications and databases suitable for migration and modernization
* Define end\-to\-end database migration and modernization strategy, architecture and roadmap on AWS
* Design scalable, highly available, resilient and secure database solutions using Amazon RDS, Aurora PostgreSQL and other AWS database services
* Architect heterogeneous database migrations from on\-premises or other cloud platforms to AWS using AWS DMS and Schema Conversion Tool (SCT)
* Define migration patterns, wave planning, cutover strategies, rollback approaches, validation and post\-migration health checks
* Provide architectural guidance for database modernization, including re\-platforming and transformation from legacy or commercial databases to PostgreSQL/Aurora PostgreSQL
* Lead database performance, scalability, security, backup, disaster recovery, monitoring and operational design
* Establish standards, best practices, reusable migration patterns and technical runbooks
* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, DevOps and business teams to address migration dependencies and technical risks
* Conduct architecture reviews, workshops and technical discussions with senior customer stakeholders
* Mentor engineering teams and provide technical leadership throughout migration and modernization programs

**Requirements**

* 12\-16 years of general IT experience
* 12\+ years of experience architecting enterprise\-scale database solutions on AWS
* Deep expertise in Amazon RDS and Aurora PostgreSQL
* Strong hands\-on and architectural knowledge of AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) and Schema Conversion Tool (SCT)
* Experience leading large\-scale and heterogeneous database migration programs
* Strong knowledge of SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL or similar enterprise relational databases
* Experience with database modernization, schema conversion, data migration, performance tuning and query optimization
* Strong understanding of AWS networking, IAM, security, encryption, monitoring, backup, high availability and disaster recovery concepts
* Experience defining migration strategies, migration waves, cutover plans, rollback procedures, validation approaches and migration runbooks
* Strong stakeholder management, consulting, architecture documentation and communication skills
* Proficiency in English at an Upper\-Intermediate level (B2\) or higher

**Nice to have**

* AWS certifications
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation
* Experience with database automation and DevOps/CI/CD practices
* Showcase of delivering complex database modernization and transformation programs in large enterprise environments

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)
